assets.name: Ivory Comb
assets.interpretation: A single ancient ivory grooming comb, wide horizontal gently arched spine, ten thick slightly uneven teeth pointing downward. A few teeth chipped short. Warm aged bone, charcoal dirt in shallow carved grooves, a thin worn antique gold repair band at one end. Three-quarter near-frontal view, melancholy humble personal possession. No hair, no skull, no extra objects.
assets.lore: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.

assets.name: Blessed Dew
assets.interpretation: One small rounded pear-shaped vial of smoky pale indigo glass, short neck and worn antique-gold stopper, dark metal foot ring. A shallow pool of softly luminous pale silver-blue dew inside and three broad condensation droplets on its outer glass. Simple sacred object with no symbol or inscription, clear pear silhouette, transparent glass represented with restrained semi-transparent areas, no background reflections.
assets.lore: It gathers on the vial overnight, from nowhere, for no one.

assets.name: Gravetender's Bell
assets.interpretation: One heavy old handheld funerary bell, broad flared cold charcoal iron cup with rubbed antique gold lip, a thick upright loop handle wrapped once in frayed muted olive cloth. Large small clapper visible in the dark interior below the angled lip. Hand-worked ridges and a few deep tally grooves without readable writing. Three-quarter frontal view. Quiet dignified care, no skulls, no extra props.
assets.lore: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.

assets.name: Wyrm Heart
assets.interpretation: One fantastical preserved dragon heart, compact anatomical heart shape with two thick vessel stumps on top. Deep muted burgundy leathery muscle merging into charcoal-black reptile scales around its lower half. Subtle warm ember-orange fissure across its central lobe implies a stubborn heartbeat. Old, heavy, magical specimen, no dripping blood, no gore spray, no pedestal, no jewelry or cage. Bold pearlike asymmetrical organic silhouette.
assets.lore: It still beats. It expects something of you.
